title: Origin story: Xbalanque
description: Xbalanque was one of the Hero Twins of the Popol Vuh, sons of the murdered Hun Hunahpu. He and his brother Hunahpu descended to Xibalba, the underworld, and defeated its lords at their own deadly ballgame through cunning — avenging their father and rising as the moon and sun.
